## midnightSetIsAuthorized() function

Encodes `Midnight.setIsAuthorized` for a bundle spender or ratifier.

Prefer requirement helpers or entity `getRequirements()` in app flows; they read `isAuthorized` first and return this transaction only when needed. Use this builder directly when the caller intentionally wants to set or revoke authorization without reading state.

**Signature:**

```typescript
midnightSetIsAuthorized: (params: MidnightSetIsAuthorizedParams) => Readonly<Transaction<MidnightAuthorizationAction>>
```

## Exceptions

`UnsupportedMidnightAuthorizationTargetError` when granting authorization to an unsupported operator.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain id used to resolve `Midnight`<!-- -->.

- `params.authorized`<!-- -->: Supported operator receiving authorization, or any operator losing authorization.

- `params.onBehalf`<!-- -->: Owner whose authorization mapping is updated.

- `params.isAuthorized`<!-- -->: Optional target state; defaults to `true`<!-- -->.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata appended to calldata.

## Example


```ts
import { midnightSetIsAuthorized } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = midnightSetIsAuthorized({
  chainId: 8453,
  authorized: midnightBundles,
  onBehalf: user,
});
```
